_how: Newest posts go at the top. date is YYYY-MM-DD, tag is one short word (cubez, site, 3d, music...), link is optional (e.g. the full Patreon post). Put your Patreon page in patreon.

posts.title: New website
posts.text: Moved off Weebly and rebuilt the whole site from scratch. It's a dive now: scroll down and it gets deeper, darker and weirder. Cube'z lives in the corner and will tell you when I'm live or post something new.
